questions.stem: According to the passage, in what year was the first Super Bowl played?
questions.evidence: The first Super Bowl was played in 1967 in Los Angeles, California.
questions.explanation_ko: 첫 슈퍼볼은 1967년 로스앤젤레스에서 열렸다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT true about the first Super Bowl in 1967?
options: It was played in Los Angeles
The Green Bay Packers defeated the Kansas City Chiefs
Many seats in the stadium were empty
It was considered a very exciting game
questions.evidence: It was not a very exciting game.
questions.explanation_ko: 1967년 첫 슈퍼볼은 그리 흥미진진한 경기가 아니었다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that the public finally accepted the new league after the Jets beat the Colts two years later?
options: The public rejected the new league even more strongly after the 1969 Super Bowl.
The Jets' 1969 victory helped the public accept the newer AFL as legitimate.
The Super Bowl was cancelled entirely after 1969.
The NFL and AFL merged before the first Super Bowl was played.
questions.evidence: Experts say the public finally accepted the new league when the New York Jets defeated the Baltimore Colts.
questions.explanation_ko: 뉴욕 제츠의 승리로 대중이 새 리그를 받아들이게 되었다는 내용에서, 1969년 슈퍼볼 결과가 AFL의 대중적 신뢰도를 높이는 데 중요한 역할을 했음을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that the Kansas City Chiefs are "the first team in NFL history to have a chance to win a third Super Bowl in a row"?
options: To highlight the historic significance of the Chiefs' potential achievement in this year's game
To argue that the Chiefs are the greatest team of all time
To explain how the playoff system works
To criticize the Philadelphia Eagles' chances
questions.evidence: The Chiefs are the first team in NFL history to have a chance to win a third Super Bowl in a row.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 설명은 이번 경기에서 치프스가 이룰 수 있는 역사적인 성취의 중요성을 강조하기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "negotiating" mean in "established NFL players began negotiating to play for the competing league"?
options: discussing terms in order to reach an agreement
questions.evidence: established NFL players began negotiating to play for the competing league
questions.explanation_ko: negotiating는 합의에 이르기 위해 조건을 논의하는 것을 뜻합니다.

blanks.expression: had success in the Big Game
blanks.sentence_ko: 두 팀 모두 이 큰 경기에서 성공을 거둔 경험이 있다.

key_points: The Super Bowl is the championship game of the NFL, which formed in 1920, and grew out of a 1960s agreement between the NFL and the rival American Football League (AFL) to hold a joint championship game.
The first Super Bowl in 1967 was not very exciting and drew many empty seats, but the public accepted the merger of leagues after the underdog New York Jets beat the Baltimore Colts two years later.
After that, the leagues merged into today's NFL, split into the American Conference (AFC) and National Conference (NFC), whose champions meet each year in the Super Bowl.
This year's Super Bowl LIX features the Kansas City Chiefs, seeking an unprecedented third consecutive championship, against the Philadelphia Eagles.
main_idea: The Super Bowl, the NFL's championship game, grew out of a 1960s merger between two rival football leagues and has since become one of the biggest annual sporting events in the world.
restate_sentence: The Super Bowl is the championship game of professional American football.
